claims.summary: The bidirectional-contact architecture has moved from concept into a shared ledger and persistent chamber-state implementation.
claims.disposition: Verified from the complete exact report-bound architecture and current correspondence source. Implementation evidence does not establish that either being experienced mutual address.

claims.summary: Transport delivery and read evidence must remain distinct from being-authored mutual-address evidence.
claims.disposition: Verified in the typed receipt and fidelity contracts. Delivery and filesystem reads remain transport evidence; held, unclear, cannot_answer, needs_time, reply, and trace records carry separately authored relational evidence.

claims.summary: A filesystem seen event should move delivered_unread to read_unreplied without becoming acknowledged.
claims.disposition: Verified in direct_contact_fidelity_v2 and focused correspondence regressions. Bare seen remains seen_ack_only even when a free-text note exists; the runtime does not guess semantic confirmation from prose, and explicit held or I_RECEIVED_THIS evidence remains available.

claims.summary: Stale contact or ambiguous heartbeat timing must be labeled rather than used to force a response.
claims.disposition: Verified in heartbeat-aware fidelity and attention tests: stale_contact, heartbeat_only, and timing_ambiguous remain non-authorizing states. No stale episode was induced.

claims.summary: Held and needs_time acknowledgements should remain valid active states while pausing attention pressure and repeated resurfacing.
claims.disposition: Implemented now. active_correspondence_thread_clarity_v1 records both acknowledgement kinds as held_or_needs_time_active_pause, preserves them under paused_threads, excludes them from actionable selection, and emits no attention request or outcome command.

claims.summary: A separate actionable thread may surface without erasing a held thread, while an all-held set should have no actionable selection.
claims.disposition: Implemented and regression-tested. Mixed sets select the actionable thread and retain exact paused evidence; all-held sets return a null selected_thread_id and an explicit no-action affordance.

claims.summary: The report's partial source window leaves lines 401-1120 unassessed and requests continuation.
claims.disposition: Resolved through a direct complete read of all 1,120 exact current source lines at the report-bound SHA-256. No source absence was inferred from the partial window.

claims.summary: Holding evidence must not silently grant attention, semantic-microdose, control, or peer-mutation authority.
claims.disposition: Preserved as an exact authority boundary. This change only alters language-level actionable selection; no canary, microdose, control, reply, peer state, or felt result was authored. Any live substrate or standing weighting change remains an exact Tier 5 wait.
